description: Cancellation races (design §6.5, frozen interface §14 item 6). Cancel is idempotent and never the outcome channel.

scenarios.name: cancel-vs-finish
scenarios.description: A natural exit races ahead of the cancel signal; the recorded outcome stands (the shim writes the true outcome on every path).

scenarios.name: cancel-on-terminal-idempotency
scenarios.description: Cancelling an already-terminal Attempt returns a CancelAck naming the terminal state, never an error.

scenarios.name: harvest-after-cancel
scenarios.description: Harvest still runs on whatever out/ holds after cancellation.

scenarios.name: harvest-after-expiry
scenarios.description: Harvest still runs on whatever out/ holds after deadline expiry.

scenarios.name: un-killable-group-member-bounded-poll
scenarios.description: If the poll ceiling elapses with the subtree non-empty (an un-killable escapee), the supervisor terminalizes anyway — failed[infrastructure] with a residual-live-processes annotation — rather than hanging non-terminal.

scenarios.name: cancel-during-provisioning
scenarios.description: A cancel arriving during the setup phase (before exec-started) terminalizes as rejected.
